title: Performance budgets use hard, soft, and target tiers with CI gates
context: Alternative approaches: no budgets; advisory budgets; all hard budgets.
decision: Schematify declares 6 performance budgets with three tiers: (1) hard budgets block CI if they fail (cold startup 2s, load 1s, frame time 16ms, search 100ms, lint 500ms); (2) soft budgets warn and need 1 human sign-off to merge; (3) target budgets are tracked and graphed but block nothing. The lint and search budgets carry the hard tier because wave acceptance blocks on them.
consequences: Critical paths are protected by hard gates; soft budgets allow trending awareness; targets track regression without forcing it; wave acceptance is gated on hard budgets only; sign-off captures human judgment on soft breaches.
